column3: “According to his strengthening” is rendered “was established and strong.”
NASB moves the reason clause forward; “acted unfaithfully” is rendered “had been unfaithful.”
NASB writes “the Lubim, the Sukkiim,” and renders “Cushites” as “Ethiopians.”
“Cities of fortifications” is rendered “fortified cities”; NASB adds “as far as.”
“Leaders” is rendered “princes.” “In the hand of Shishak” is rendered “to Shishak,” and “abandoned” as “forsaken.”
NASB supplies “so.” “Like a little to deliverance” is rendered “some measure of deliverance,” and “by the hand of” as “by means of.”
“Subjects” is rendered “slaves”; “know my service” is rendered “learn the difference between My service.”
“On the hand of” is rendered “to the care of,” and “the runners” as “the guard.”
“Not to destroy to complete destruction” is rendered “so as not to destroy him completely”; “things good” is rendered “conditions were good.”
Word order is changed in the clause about the chosen city.

“Matters” is rendered “acts,” and “words” as “records.” “For genealogical enrollment” is rendered “according to genealogical enrollment”; the meaning is uncertain. “All the days” is rendered “continually.”
